interpretations.plain_english_summary: This was a procedural vote on whether to pull forward a resolution that sought to block a proposed U.S. foreign military sale to the United Arab Emirates. It was not a final vote blocking or approving the sale.
interpretations.yea_meaning: A Yea vote supported discharging the resolution so the Senate could move closer to considering a measure that would prohibit the proposed sale.
interpretations.nay_meaning: A Nay vote opposed discharging the resolution, leaving the proposed sale-disapproval measure from advancing through this motion.
interpretations.policy_effect: If the motion had succeeded, the Senate would have moved the disapproval resolution forward for possible consideration. The underlying resolution, if enacted later, would prohibit the proposed foreign military sale of certain defense articles and services to the United Arab Emirates.
interpretations.interpretation_reason: Manual review treated the motion to discharge as a procedural vote to advance a sale-disapproval resolution, not as final enactment of the underlying prohibition.
